manifest.claim_text: The compiler produces a model whose shapes, units, frames, delays and masks are internally consistent.
manifest.falsified_by: any offset overlap, undeclared unit/frame/clock, negative or unrepresentable delay, or a mask that does not match the declared operator set
manifest.consequence_if_failed: Fix the compiler before any claim-bearing run; a numerically inconsistent compilation invalidates every downstream gate.
non_goals: These checks establish code correctness only. Numerical correctness is necessary, never sufficient: agreement with recorded signals is stronger, held-out perturbation stronger still (thesis §0.2).
